title: Algebra-sheaf module functor, chart evaluation, embedded ideals and sheafification on an algebraic-space etale site
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale site and structure sheaf [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the commutative structure sheaf, the category of commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebra sheaves (the under category of that sheaf in commutative ring sheaves, with no quasi-coherence restriction) and their underlying $\mathcal O_X$-modules (the rank-one module restricted along the structure morphism) of [def-sfb-space-quasi-coherent-algebra]. Taking underlying modules is a functor to $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]: algebra morphisms act by their section maps. Evaluation at a chart $U$ is the functor to the under category of the commutative ring $\mathcal O_X(U)$, i.e. the ordinary category of $\mathcal O_X(U)$-algebras with their specified scalar maps. An embedded ideal in an algebra $A$ is a monomorphism $I\to A$ of $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves whose image on the sections of every object is an ideal of $A(U)$. Such images have local membership since $I$ is a sheaf and its inclusion is a monomorphism. The affine etale basis, which has a small skeleton in the section universe, gives left-exact additive sheafification in that same universe on the full small etale site; it inverts exactly the locally bijective maps. These are the usual sheafification structures supporting algebra and module constructions, with no coefficient lift or restriction on $X$.
